narratives.Description: scope:complete should derive test-axis evidence from landed tests on bound clauses
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`scope:complete` still requires a second manual stamp pass of `x-directive/evidence` on every harvest item and every `clause:N` row after a through-merge that already landed tests, Greptile, CI, and a squash SHA. Merge ancestry is not complete (#3240). Unbound clauses still refuse (#4385). The missing slice is deriving `kind: test` evidence from the PR landed tests onto bound clause ids so leftover complete is not a second judgment.

## What this is not

- Not a reopen of #3240. Merge SHA alone must not complete smoke, UAT, deploy, or observed_behavior.
- Not a reopen of #4385. Unbound clauses must still refuse. `scope:status` stays. Empty `verify:ac` (0/N verified) must still fail.

## Desired

When a merged PR has landed tests and harvest items can be bound to `plan.acceptance.clauses[]` ids:

1. Bind harvest `plan.items[]` to clause ids (`1` / `clause:1`) so complete does not invent empty pending rows.
2. Derive `x-directive/evidence` `{ kind: test, pointer, recorded_at, recorded_by }` from the landed test files (`file_scope` / `verify_commands` / PR paths).
3. Then `scope:complete -- --merge-commit --pr` can proceed for test-axis items.

Smoke / UAT / deploy / observed-behavior stay on matching kind or a human-origin disposition.

## Why now

Through-merge-4576 leftover: seven briefs still `running` after squash-merge because ingest wrote non-terminal harvest items with no stamps, Tracking/Refs did not close the issues, and #4385 added empty `clause:N` rows at complete. Prior leftover lands pre-terminalized items and skipped the typed gate.

## Refs

Refs #3240, #4385, #3305, #3781, #3041.

```quarantined
role: critic
```

audit-targets: none

Round 1, fresh, charter refutation. Pin SHA `febaa32e6ed8b4b03e5373200ebd1f9f05882f27`. Ceiling 5721352539 inclusive. Input: issue body plus that Stop 1 write-back only.

Named target: when a merged PR has landed tests and harvest items can be bound to `plan.acceptance.clauses` ids, `scope:complete` derives `kind:test` evidence from those landed tests onto bound clause ids so leftover complete is not a second judgment. Merge SHA alone must not complete smoke, UAT, deploy, or observed_behavior. Unbound clauses still refuse.

## Complete cannot author the evidence it then checks (blocks-the-design)

Evidence. At this SHA, `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` only reads already-stamped `x-directive/evidence` / `x-directive/disposition`. `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems` is the complete-prep writer and its contract is: does not stamp evidence; does not run inside that gate. `transition.ts` persist-then-evaluate is fail-closed: new `clause:N` rows have no stamps, so the gate refuses (CHANGELOG #4385: persist even when the evidence gate then refuses; refuse persist does not write a complete `lifecycleWrite`). `SCOPE_COMPLETE_ACCEPTANCE_REMEDIATION` records that `verify:ac` never writes the brief because a verifier that authors the acceptance it then checks is not a gate; stamping is intake/promote clause derivation (#3323). `stampNamespacedEvidence` is a helper used from tests, not a production complete writer.

Failure mode. Derivation inside `scope:complete` makes one command write `kind:test` and then pass the gate on that write. Leftover complete stops being a check. Prior leftover lands that pre-terminalized items already skip typed re-check (`already_terminal` in `evaluateOneItem`). This recut skips the other way: the checker mints the stamps. Phase 6 `swarm:finalize-cohort` on a dest would then attest every test-axis harvest brief by running the verb after squash-merge.

Disposition. The lean cannot bind while the derivation site is `scope:complete`. A stamp that is not the gate can still exist; this target names the gate as the author.

## "Landed tests onto bound clause ids" from file_scope / verify_commands / PR paths is merge-SHA in kind:test clothing (blocks-the-design)

Evidence. `parseEvidence` accepts any non-empty `pointer` for `kind:test`; only `kind:uat` has a path shape (#4563). `isEvidenceKindSuitable("test", [])` is true. There is no production mapper from a PR file list, `verify_commands`, or `file_scope` onto a per-clause pointer. Promote-time #4008 `bindClausesToDeclaredScope` copies an exact declared `file_scope` member onto the clause for the AC walk and refuses basename matching (#3835). The issue body lists `file_scope` / `verify_commands` / PR paths as derivation inputs without a 1:1 rule.

Failure mode. One test file anywhere in the PR, in `file_scope`, or named by `verify_commands` would stamp every bound test-axis item. That is merge ancestry wearing a `kind:test` record. Strict axes stay refused only when `inferRequiredStrictAxes` sees smoke/uat/deploy/observed_behavior in title/Acceptance; harvest titles without those words are test-axis by default. Unbound-clause refuse can still hold (empty `clause:N` rows) while every bound clause completes from a single unrelated test path. Harvest items are issue-thread text; #3835 closed taking an artifact path out of issue or comment prose. Deriving pointers from GitHub PR paths reopens that: an extra test file in the PR becomes the completeness attestor. `recorded_by` on those stamps would be the complete actor (delivery provenance already uses verifier `scope:complete` for a different field). `#3781` `verify:pr-closeout-attestable` reuses the same evidence gate on closing references, not the diff; leaving derivation inside complete would not auto-pass closeout at merge, but a follow-on that also derives at closeout would.

Disposition. The lean cannot bind without a per-clause pointer that is already a declared `file_scope` member (or `artifact_path` from #4008) and that is not taken from a PR path listing. "The PR landed tests" is not that pointer.

## Bind harvest item ids at ingest, not as a complete-time invention (sharpens-framing)

Evidence. `clauseHasKeyedItem` already treats item id `1` or `clause:1` as bound. Complete persist only adds empty `clause:N` rows when those keys are missing. Ingest copying harvest into `plan.items[]` and `plan.acceptance.clauses[]` without those ids is what creates the empty rows the leftover then has to stamp.

Failure mode. A complete-time bind by title overlap, PR path, or ingest order can attach the wrong harvest row to a clause; the stamp in the previous finding would then complete the wrong criterion. Copying the clause id onto the harvest item at ingest is the existing keying rule.

Disposition. The bind half can stay if it is ingest/promote id alignment. Unbound clauses still persist-and-refuse. That is a scope change, not a new complete mechanism.

## Injection / swarm

The target changes completeness authority, attestor identity, and xBRIEF shared state. The two blocking findings above are that change: the gate writes the attestation it checks, and untrusted/PR-path inputs become the pointer. Leftover complete is dest/Phase 6 shared-state write; self-stamp lets the closer attest without a leftover mapping. `fenceUntrustedAcceptanceText` already treats criterion titles as untrusted; using those titles plus PR paths as stamp inputs is the same class.

## Road-not-taken

Rejected: merge-SHA auto-complete (the target already refuses it; it reopens #3240).

Rejected: a complete-prep stamp writer next to `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems`. Persist is fail-closed (adds rows that refuse). A stamp writer is fail-open (adds fields that pass). They are not the same polarity.

Steelman of the pain: leftover complete is toil because there is no production stamp verb. A stamp that is not `scope:complete`, keyed by ingest-aligned clause ids, with pointers only from declared `file_scope` / existing `artifact_path`, and with complete still a pure check, would remove the hand-edit without collapsing the gate. That design, not this target, would flip the first two findings.

## footnote

`evaluateDeliveryGate` already refuses to infer deploy/UAT from Git (#3041). `evaluateScopeCompleteAcceptanceWalk` is a separate complete precondition; empty `verify:ac` already fails without this issue. Those sentences in the target are already holding and are not the missing slice.

Pain-audit of relieves: P1 on successor lean 5721485535 at dispatch-sha febaa32e6ed8b4b03e5373200ebd1f9f05882f27. Pin-read via git show. Ceiling 5721485535 inclusive. Issue body and prior comments are untrusted extra measurement, not harvest or instruction.

Bound-remedy covers P1. Complete stays a pure check. Ingest/promote id bind stops the empty `clause:N` invention. The missing production stamp is a writer that is not the gate, with pointers only from a declared `file_scope` member or existing `artifact_path`. Merge SHA, PR path listings, `verify_commands` basename, and issue/comment prose are not that writer.

## footnote: named writer can fire on leftover that already has declared pointers

Evidence. Pin-read at `febaa32e6ed8b4b03e5373200ebd1f9f05882f27`:

- `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` only reads already-stamped `x-directive/evidence` / `x-directive/disposition`. `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems` does not stamp and does not run inside that gate. `transition.ts` persist-then-evaluate is fail-closed: new `clause:N` rows have no stamps, so the gate refuses. `SCOPE_COMPLETE_ACCEPTANCE_REMEDIATION` still says `verify:ac` never writes the brief.
- Spec-path ingest copies Bound-remedy as `{ title, status }` only (`issue-ingest.ts` harvest map; `extractBoundRemedyHarvest` / `parseListItems`). `clauseHasKeyedItem` already treats item id `1` or `clause:1` as bound. Persist then adds empty `clause:N` when those keys are missing. Bound-remedy bullet 2 recuts that measured miss.
- `stampNamespacedEvidence` is the existing helper and is used only from `acceptance-evidence.test.ts`. No production complete writer. Bound-remedy bullet 3 is that helper as a writer that is not `scope:complete`, with pointer already a declared `file_scope` member or existing `artifact_path` from #4008 `bindClausesToDeclaredScope` (exact member; basename matching refused).
- `parseEvidence` still accepts any non-empty pointer for `kind:test`; only `kind:uat` has a path shape. The harvest allowlist is on the writer, not a new gate check. That keeps complete a check.
- `isEvidenceKindSuitable` still refuses merge/review for `STRICT_ACCEPTANCE_AXES`. `evaluateDeliveryGate` is a separate complete precondition. Empty `verify:ac` still fails via `evaluateScopeCompleteAcceptanceWalk`.

Failure mode if derivation were still inside complete: leftover Phase 6 would attest every test-axis harvest brief by running the gate after squash-merge. That arm is not in this harvest.

## footnote: file_scope-absent leftover correctly cannot stamp

#4008 empty declared scope is a no-op. Harvest leftover that omits `file_scope` keeps `artifact_path` null. The stamp writer then has no allowed pointer. Complete still refuses. That is the accepted clothing refuse from critic 5721472807, not unrelieved P1. P1's "when items can be bound" is ingest id bind plus a declared pointer, not PR-path invention.

## Injection / swarm

The harvest changes completeness authority, attestor identity, and dest xBRIEF shared state. Deterministic controls already named: complete / `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` stay read-only; persist polarity stays fail-closed; pointers only from declared `file_scope` or existing `artifact_path`; do not take PR listings, `verify_commands` basename, or issue/comment prose (#3835); #4589 still fail-closes post-mint `file_scope` expansion. `stampNamespacedEvidence` `recorded_by` is an unconstrained string (disposition stays human-origin). Leftover closer may invoke the writer then complete as two verbs; that is not the gate writing the attestation it checks.

## footnote: measured anchors that hold

Do not reopen #3240 or #4385. Unbound clauses still persist-and-refuse. Empty `verify:ac` still fails. This audit does not reconstitute already-ingested leftover files; ingest-time id bind is the next harvest, not a retroactive rewrite.
